title: spec: register ADR-0087 semantic upgrade-guide entries for the two runtime-gate flow narrowings (flow-node-unreachable, flow-start-node-missing)
body:
domain:spec#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzh7cM8EmUX4T2CBNHX

## What is missing

Two lint rules on the runtime authoring gate now refuse a live save and a publish of a flow shape that used to store:

- `flow-node-unreachable` (#31224)
- `flow-start-node-missing` (#32289 / PR #32340)

Both are protocol narrowings (`Metadata-protocol: narrowed`). Neither registers an ADR-0087 semantic upgrade-guide entry under `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/`. The picklist precedent does register one: `18.picklist-binding-unknown-refused.ts` (#29898).

`check-adr-0087-registration` passes both PRs. It refuses `no-migration-prescription` only when the changeset body carries an arrow rewrite or a framed-table rewrite, and these bodies prescribe the fix in prose, which the detector does not read. So the green is a pass by the rule as written, not proof that no entry is owed. The contract review on PR #32340 (comment 6778668057, ② and nit 5) recommended this card.

## Ask

- Add one semantic entry per rule, in the shape of the picklist entry. Each entry gives what used to store, what is refused now, and the fix. For `flow-start-node-missing` the fix is to add a top-level `start` node. For `flow-node-unreachable` it is to wire the node from the start node or delete it. Each entry also says what happens to rows stored before the release.
- Decide whether `check-adr-0087-registration` should also read a prose prescription, or whether `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` alone should require an entry. Name the decision; changing the gate is optional and may be a separate card.

Depends on PR #32340 landing first.
